# Starfall Education

> > Starfall is a comprehensive K-5 educational platform offering interactive games, phonics instruction, reading, and math content designed for diverse learners including those with dyslexia and English language learners.

Founded by Dr. Stephen Schutz, Starfall Education Foundation provides multisensory, phonics-based learning experiences through interactive games, movies, books, and music. The platform serves both classroom and home learners with accessibility standards and specialized support for students with special needs.

## Key Topics

- Phonics-based instruction
- K-5 elementary education
- Interactive educational games
- Reading and language arts
- Mathematics instruction
- Multisensory learning
- Special needs education
- English language learners (ELL/ESL)
- Dyslexia support
- Parent-Teacher resources
- WCAG 2.1 accessibility
- Phonemic awareness
- Homeschool resources
- kidSAFE Seal Program

## Core Learning Platform

- [Starfall Education: Kids Games, Movies, Books & Music for K-5 and above](https://www.starfall.com/h): Starfall's main homepage for K-5 educational games, reading, phonics, and math
- [Parent-Teacher Center | Starfall](https://teach.starfall.com): Parent-Teacher Center offering worksheets, lesson plans for K-3 Math and ELA

## About & Mission

- [Starfall Parent-Teacher Center - About Us](https://teach.starfall.com/about): About Starfall Education Foundation: history, mission, and founder Stephen Schutz

## Accessibility & Support

- [Starfall Accessibility](https://starfall.com/h/accessibility.php): Starfall's WCAG 2.1 accessibility statement and inclusive learning standards
